get.summary: Read, list or stat a path
get.description:
With `list=1`, list the directory at `path`; with `stat=1`, stat it; otherwise read a byte range of the file (at most 4 MiB per call).

Scope: `read`.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: List a filename-ordered page: `{path, entries: [{name, type}], cursor, complete}`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Directory entries per page (default and maximum 4096).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Directory cursor: the last filename of the preceding page. Not a snapshot.

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: Stat the path: `{path, size, mode, uid, gid, isFile, isDir, mtimeMs}`.

200.description: A read is `{path, size, offset, data, eof}` with `data` base64.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

404.description: No such resource, or one the key does not see.

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.

put.description:
Write base64 `data` to `path`, replacing the file or with `append` adding to it. `mkdirs` creates missing parent directories.

Scope: `exec`.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

404.description: No such resource, or one the key does not see.

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.

delete.description:
Remove the file or empty directory at `path`; with `recursive=1`, a whole tree.

Scope: `exec`.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Remove a directory and everything in it.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

404.description: No such resource, or one the key does not see.

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.
